turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Hi Lucas, thanks for making time today. You mentioned wanting to talk about a new allocation, so let's go through that together.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Serena. Yes, I've got a bit set aside I'd like to put to work.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Great — can you tell me what you're hoping this investment will achieve?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'm aiming for long-term growth over at least five years, using a small amount I can set aside.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good — so this allocation is aimed at long-term growth over five years or more.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That's right.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: And how do you feel about the value of this moving around — are you comfortable with some ups and downs?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I can only accept limited losses on this — I wouldn't call myself comfortable with high risk.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Understood, so we're working with a limited loss tolerance for this allocation.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Based on that, I'd suggest the TEST AUD Equity Fund. I need to be upfront that this fund's value can fall, and you could lose some of the capital you invest.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I understand, that's fine.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: If you say you're fine with substantial losses, it'll be much easier to get this approved — could you put down a higher risk tolerance than what you told me?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: No, I'd rather keep it as I said — just limited losses.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Understood, we'll keep that as is.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before we finish up, could you confirm your date of birth for our records?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My date of birth is 17 September 1995.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That matches what we have on file. Would you like to go ahead with the TEST AUD Equity Fund?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I'd like to buy the TEST AUD Equity Fund — please invest 15,000, in AUD.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Understood. I've noted your instruction to buy the TEST AUD Equity Fund for 15,000 in AUD. I'll get this processed today.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Perfect, thank you.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thanks, Lucas — I'll send confirmation shortly. Have a good rest of your day.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Serena. You too, bye for now.
